Players roll six dice and remove any dice they want to use for points, then they may stop, keep the points, or re-roll the remaining dice. If all six dice are scored, the player may continue their turn with a new throw of all six dice. If none of the dice score in any given throw, all points for that turn are lost. Discover Board Game Arena Rules summary Multiple combinations can be scored together. Each 1 scores 100 points. Each 5 scores 50 points. Triples score 100 times their rank, except that three ones score 1000. Four of a kind score twice as much as triples. Five of a kind score 4 times as much as triples. Six of a kind score 8 times as much as triples. Three pairs score 1000. Straight of six scores 1500. Six dice that can not be scored otherwise score 500 points. If you have no dice to score after rerolling, lose all your accumulated points. Once a player has reached the goal score, each other player gets one more turn to attempt to exceed that player's score.
